The prepositions in the text are:

1.  **Among** (connects "the crowd" to the main clause, indicating location/position)
2.  **for** (connects "inspiration" to "searched", indicating purpose/direction)
3.  **from** (connects "face" to "moving", indicating origin/source)
4.  **to** (connects "face" to "from", indicating direction/target)
5.  **in** (connects "the hustle and bustle of the city" to "here", indicating location)
6.  **of** (connects "the city" to "hustle and bustle", indicating possession/association)
7.  **for** (connects "her next creation" to "spark", indicating purpose/benefit)

The name of the planet humans live on is Earth.
